context.transcript:
lđ
Are you looking for a fun family getaway this summer?
Come join us at Robinson's Resort, home of the largest
water park on the east coast. We just completed renovating
the entire park, and there are now six outdoor pools and nine
new waterslides to enjoy! After a day full of fun in the sun,
unwind in the comfort of rooms with a wood-cabin aesthetic
feel as though you are far from the city. Call 555-0179 now
to book a weekend your family will never forget!
halita
